# platform-repo-path-baseline — hardcoded /Users/Shared/evolve-repo
# deploy-checkout literals in a path-resolution context (Path()/
# os.path.*/cwd=) per file. Generated by `tools/platform-path-lint
# --rule repo --all --update-baseline`. The deploy checkout is
# /var/lib/evolve/repo on Linux, so a hardcoded macOS literal breaks
# path resolution on Linux pods — resolve via
# platform_profile.get_profile().deploy_checkout_default instead. The
# lint blocks any file that EXCEEDS its count, so this file may only
# ratchet DOWN. Goal state: empty (deploy-checkout path class fully
# platform-keyed).
